validatedStructural.formula: 0.70 * prior-season centered average scoring-margin strength + 1.0 generic HFA; neutral games use 0 HFA
excludedFromNumericalWeight: QB points in the market-aware production center

spreadCalibration.rule: 3.0+ validated-structural-vs-market points = high-priority audit/research, never automatic bet.

marketAwareProduction.productionRule: Primary predictive spread = 80% current market + 20% validated structural line.

qbCalibration.deltaRule: expected current QB value minus QB value embedded in baseline

marketBlendTest.rule: QB remains scenario/audit input; it receives no additional numerical production weight on top of market because the QB-aware market blend did not improve holdout.

inSeasonPriorDecay.ratingDefinition: preseason=0.70*centered prior-season average margin; live=centered current-season average margin through prior week
inSeasonPriorDecay.rule: These supersede the earlier ridge-rating phase schedule because they were calibrated using the exact v1.1 structural/live rating definitions. Do not retune from weekly 2026 outcomes.

totals.productionRule: Production total = 100% current market; independent baseline total is research context only.

currentPersonnelAndExperts.role: diagnostic/blocking/uncertainty only until a reliable historical transition calibration passes holdout

source: nflverse historical schedules/results/play-by-play/closing lines; current public markets and personnel evidence maintained separately
caveats: Current market prices may move before close.
Very large structural edges can indicate stale priors rather than value; audit layers can block them.
Same-sample ATS threshold rates require prospective 2026 CLV/outcome validation.
